metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the no-deps Node.js iCalendar tool under `output/`:

- Entry point: `output/main.js` (also added a thin wrapper `output/ical`)
- Subcommands:
  - `node output/main.js parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
  - `node output/main.js expand --input <path.ics> --from <YYYY-MM-DD|...Z> --to <YYYY-MM-DD|...Z> --output <out.json>`

Key implementation files:
- ICS parsing/unfolding/param decoding: `output/src/ics/parse_ics.js`, `output/src/ics/unfold.js`, `output/src/ics/syntax.js`, `output/src/ics/text.js`
- Schema mapping (`parse`): `output/src/ical/parse_output.js`
- RRULE parsing/expansion: `output/src/ical/rrule.js`, `output/src/ical/recurrence_expand.js`, `output/src/ical/recurrence.js`
- VTIMEZONE resolution + fold/gap warnings: `output/src/ical/timezone.js`
- RECURRENCE-ID override handling + `expand` output: `output/src/ical/expand.js`
- Warning emission + dedup: `output/src/warnings.js`
